summary: Fetch release-delivery snapshots from the verified local source and clean abandoned Git transfer packs under the delivery lock.

schema.detail: No persistent delivery-state or database schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule changes; trusted commit ancestry and monotonic build protections remain enforced.

compatibility.detail: For origin branches, delivery now reads the configured source repository's remote-tracking ref and transfers its exact snapshot locally instead of downloading objects from the network. Snapshot outcomes include commit SHA, ref and commit time.

downtime.detail: No live scheduler activation or app installation is performed by this source change.

manual.detail: Deployment owners must adopt the reviewed worker source and ensure the configured local source repository's origin remote-tracking ref is refreshed. Delivery no longer refreshes that ref over the network.

recovery.detail: Failed fetches kill and reap their transfer group before temporary pack/index cleanup under the existing delivery lock. Subsequent fetches reclaim older abandoned transfer files. Trusted observations remain available for existing offline retry behavior.
